title: A zero-copy CSV line reader
hints: Keep the part of the line you have not read yet in a `ReadOnlySpan<char>` field. Each `MoveNext` finds the next comma, hands out the slice before it, and keeps the slice after it. A flag remembers that the last field has been given.
`int.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>)` parses straight from the slice. `line[..^1]` drops the last character (the `\r`).
